title: Integration/main to releases 29.x 31a860b5
summary: Integration of 46 commits from main into the BC29 release branch includes enhancements to e-document processing, expense report policy evaluations, agent features, and various localization and financial modules.
key_points: Integrates 46 commits from main into releases/29.x, keeping the original order and SHAs
Expense Agent gains policy evaluation tables, pages, enums and APIs, including posted evaluations
E-Document, AgentDesignExperience, Sales Order Agent, Shopify, Sustainability, Withholding Tax and Excel Reports apps are modified
German e-document (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, PEPPOL) and US IRS 1099 code and Base Application objects also change
quote: Final integration from main into releases/29.x, including all changes through commit 31a860b527f0dc72c7a44a255d7e7d403cfa4789.
